title: BPW-2026-0636

[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0636
Specification submitted for Board adoption and authorization to advertise for the Invitation of Bids:
CD 9
Central Business District (CBD) Sewer Rehabilitation Unit 1 – Jefferson Boulevard to Exposition Boulevard
W.O.: SZC14384
Estimate: $27,822,275
Bid Receipt Date: Wednesday, January 13, 2027
summary: Board of Public Works is being asked to approve bid specifications and authorize advertising for a sewer rehabilitation in the Central Business District along Jefferson Boulevard to Exposition Boulevard, with an estimate of $27,822,275 and bids due January 13, 2027.

locations.text: Jefferson Blvd & Exposition Blvd, Los Angeles, CA
